messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
Interpret last night‘s dream: it’s a bit scattered and I don’t remember chunks or context other than I was in an office setting I believe as part of an interview process. I don’t remember which person was doing the hiring or had final decision, but I spent the entire day with a group of guys that I really got along with. I was especially intrigued with one guy who was openly running a side business from the office building. He sold these long light up piano keys and carried them around in a clear bag. I asked him how much a key cost and he said $500.

One of the other guys for some reason was handing me a dollar bill that he owed me from something, but handed me a stack of international currency because he said he didn’t need any of it anymore. The currency was from all over the world and seemed like a lot of money. It was a huge stack and after he handed it to me, I felt like I was carrying a weeks worth of junk mail in my hands.

For some reason, I also had to keep going out to the parking lot to escort in other people. We did it as a group and I would talk to the people we were escorting in, but I kept looking at the guy carrying the clear plastic bag filled with light up piano keys. He took the bag everywhere he went.  The end.

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Also ~ The guy that handed me all the money was blown away when I told him that I saw the monkees with Gary Puckett and the union gap,  Herman’s Hermits, and the Grass Roots at the Civic Arena with the roof open.
